title: Workout of the day says 'Members see it now' even when no member uses the app
what: The workout of the day and workout plans for everyone on a membership reach members only through the MettleUp app. In the test gym none of its 2 members is linked to the app, yet saving the workout of the day says 'Saved. Members see it now.' and the plan builder says members see it after one check-in. The owner believes the workout reached the floor when nobody can see it.
expected: The workout of the day and the plan builder say how many members use the app (for example '0 of 2 members use the app yet') and point to sharing the app link when it is none or very few.
how_often: every workout of the day in a gym where few members use the app
fix_line: Show how many members use the app next to the save button, and change 'Members see it now' when it is none

title: Members and Collections search find nobody when a mobile is pasted with a 0 in front or in Hindi digits
what: The Members list search and the Collections search compare the digits typed with the member's saved mobile. A pasted '09876543210' keeps its 0, so it is not inside the saved number and nobody is found. Hindi keyboard digits are thrown away, so they find nothing either. Driven in node: '09876543210' and '९८७६५४३२१०' find no one, '+91 98765 43210' works. The desk thinks the member is not on the list and may add them twice.
expected: Both searches clean a typed number with the same rule as the mobile boxes, so a 0 in front, +91, spaces and Indian digits all find the member.
how_often: each search with a pasted or Hindi-keyboard number
fix_line: Run the search digits through the shared mobile rule before comparing

title: The gym's phone typed in Hindi digits is saved as typed, so the web page says there is no phone
what: The gym Phone box in Settings changes a number only when it has +91 in front. A 10-digit mobile typed or pasted in Hindi digits is saved exactly as typed. The web page then greys out 'Show my gym's phone number' and says 'Add your gym's phone number in Settings first', while Settings shows a number; receipts print it in Hindi digits. Driven in node: '९८७६५४३२१०' stays as typed and the web page check refuses it.
expected: The gym Phone box turns Indian keyboard digits into 0-9 always, as the mobile boxes do, while still leaving landlines and two numbers as typed.
how_often: rare: only when the number is typed on a Hindi keyboard
fix_line: Turn Indian digits into 0-9 in the gym phone box before anything else

items.note: Crispy Curves, 2 members: birthday 1/2, phone 2/2, check-in phone 1/2, app link 0/2, plan start and end 1/1, trainer 0/2, batch 0/2.

Training progress says members show once they use the app and tells the owner to give each a trainer on the member page; the batch filter counts members without a batch; the web page sends the owner to Settings for the gym phone. Birthday, batch and trainer are asked on the member form and page (outside this area).

App link is 0/2: workout of the day and plans for everyone say members see it (new finding); sending a plan to one member never says they will not get it (already found). Training progress, Questions and Member messages have honest empty states. Trainer 0/2 and batch 0/2 are optional filters here.

Driven in node: gym phone +91 forms clean to 10 digits, a landline and '98765 43210' stay as typed, Hindi 10 digits stay as typed (finding 03). Searches miss a 0 in front and Hindi digits (finding 02). UPI ID and UTR drop spaces and dashes; GSTIN is trimmed and upper-cased. Plan price and Pay MettleUp amount refuse Hindi digits or 'Rs' (already found); reps and kg boxes drop Hindi digits (same as the measurement boxes, already found). No mobile number box with a length limit in this area.
No box here cuts a real mobile autofill. The gym phone keeps Hindi digits as typed (finding 03); money boxes refuse Hindi digits with a message (already found).
